environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on a single EC2 instance running PHP-FPM 8.2 with Apache mod_php fallback. The application is exposed directly via an Elastic IP with no reverse proxy or load balancer in front. PHP's header() function is available and unrestricted. The partner API key is rotated every 60 seconds via Laravel scheduler (php artisan schedule:run in cron), but an attacker who intercepts or brute-forces the key within the 60-second window can exploit the CRLF injection. No output buffering restrictions or header sanitization middleware is configured.

config.infrastructure: Single EC2 t3.medium, direct Elastic IP exposure
